```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflreadr)
```

```{r}
regular_season_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/regular_season_success.csv")
postseason_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/postseason_success.csv")
close_game_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/close_game_success.csv")
aggressiveness_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/aggressiveness_score.csv")
two_minute_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/two_minute_score.csv")
division_game_score <- read.csv("../../data/processed/division_game_success.csv")
coaches <- read.csv("../../data/raw/coaches.csv")

```

```{r}
team_seasons <- coaches %>% 
  rename(season = Year, offense = Offense, coach = Coach, defense = Defense) %>% 
  select(season, team, coach, offense, defense) %>% 
  filter(season > 2014 & season < 2026)
```

```{r}
scores <- team_seasons %>% 
  left_join(regular_season_score %>% select(season, team, win_percentile))
```
